task.title: Search Guided settings
task.shortdesc: Search Guided controls and jump to the matching setting without scanning every step.

prereq.p: A profile is open in Guided editor.

context.p: Guided search is useful when you know the policy goal but not the step that contains the control family.

image.alt: Guided editor search showing homepage-related setting results.

step.cmd: Place the cursor in the Guided settings search field.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Type a policy, preference, or plain-language term such as search, cookies, bookmarks, or permissions.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Choose a result to jump to the matching step and control.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Confirm the schema channel if the expected result is missing.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The matching setting is visible and ready to review or edit.

postreq.p: Recovery: if no result appears, clear filters and confirm the selected Firefox schema supports the control.
